release_name: Promote beta to production: Feast Awareness, Schedule Reconciliation, Feast Document Viewer
notes: Promotes mauritius-mass-finder-beta v27.5.0 to production (last promotion was v27.3.10; the v27.3.11 quick-day-filter hotfix was already present in the beta lineage, so nothing is lost). Key changes vs last production: (1) Feast Day Awareness - the app warns when a feast day may change Mass times, with a 14-day horizon. (2) Full schedule reconciliation against the diocese's restructured site (all 410 source URLs remapped after their /paroisses-messes/ redesign; 10 time corrections; 13 additions; 1 Mass/non-Mass day-swap fix at Sainte-Therese-d'Avila; 9 rows removed on explicit editorial decision because no diocese page lists them, archived and restorable). (3) Feast Document Viewer (new, v27.5.0) - a read-only, verbatim facsimile of the diocese's own feast-day schedule table, reached only via a contextual link on an affected card/hero/results-strip, never a standing menu item; no document has been ingested yet for the two known 2026 feasts (Toussaint, Noel), so the viewer has nothing to show until a real PDF is processed. Corpus now carries 413 rows (was 410).
